name: kharna_bgm
caption: Instrumental Indian devotional background score for a short festival-guide video, calm warm intimate mood with gentle hopeful devotion, dusk in a village courtyard with a glowing clay stove. Soft bansuri flute melody, harmonium, tanpura drone, light tabla and manjira, soft temple bell accents, faint sitar. Sacred, peaceful, homely, warm, no vocals, no singing, no chant, steady slow gentle rhythm.
